lessons.title: Vocabulary and context
lessons.body: Synonyms express similar meanings; antonyms express opposite meanings. Determine the word’s meaning from context before choosing.

lessons.title: Subject–verb agreement
lessons.body: Singular subjects generally require singular verbs. Words such as each and every are treated as singular when they are the subject.
lessons.example: Example: Each applicant has an identification card.

lessons.title: Percentages and discounts
lessons.body: To calculate p percent of a number, multiply by p/100. To calculate a discounted price, subtract the discount from the original price.

lessons.title: Ratios and sequences
lessons.body: For a ratio a:b, the total parts are a+b. In number patterns, inspect differences and multiplication factors.
lessons.example: Example: Girls in a 2:3 ratio of 30 students = 30 × 3/5 = 18.

lessons.title: Deductive reasoning
lessons.body: Distinguish statements that must follow from premises from those that may be true. Avoid assuming relationships not given.
lessons.example: Example: All roses are flowers; this does not mean all flowers are roses.

lessons.title: Alphabetical filing
lessons.body: Compare names letter by letter, starting at the beginning. If initial letters match, continue to the first differing character.

lessons.title: The Philippine Constitution
lessons.body: The 1987 Constitution is the supreme law of the Philippines and establishes the structure of government and fundamental rights.
lessons.example: Study the three branches of government and their functions.

lessons.title: Public service ethics
lessons.body: RA 6713 provides standards of conduct for public officials and employees, including accountability and professionalism.
lessons.example: Practice questions may ask which actions reflect ethical public service.

lessons.title: Reading comprehension: main idea
lessons.body: Identify the author's central claim before evaluating details. Distinguish evidence from the main conclusion.
lessons.example: Shortcut: summarise each paragraph in five words, then choose the option supported by the whole passage.

lessons.title: Elimination in grammar questions
lessons.body: Check subject–verb agreement, pronoun reference, verb tense, and parallelism systematically.
lessons.example: Shortcut: remove answers with an obvious agreement error before comparing subtler alternatives.

lessons.title: Mental maths: fractions and percentages
lessons.example: Shortcut: 12.5% of 320 is 320÷8=40; no long multiplication needed.

lessons.title: Word problems: units and rates
lessons.body: Underline the quantity asked for, list known values and units, then choose the operation.
lessons.example: Shortcut: speed = distance/time; estimate the magnitude before selecting.

lessons.title: Back-solving from answer choices
lessons.body: When options are numerical, substitute a plausible option into the original condition.
lessons.example: Shortcut: test the middle options first if values are ordered; verify the full equation.

lessons.title: Conditional reasoning
lessons.body: For P→Q, knowing P allows Q; knowing Q alone does not establish P.
lessons.example: Shortcut: draw arrows and watch for reversing the conditional.

lessons.title: Ordering and ranking puzzles
lessons.body: Represent relative positions with arrows or a simple row; preserve every constraint.
lessons.example: Shortcut: place the strongest fixed relationships first and eliminate contradictory choices.

lessons.title: Number patterns: differences
lessons.body: Check differences, ratios, alternating sequences, squares and cubes.
lessons.example: Shortcut: differences 3,5,7,9 suggest the next difference is 11.

lessons.title: Branches of Philippine government
lessons.body: The legislature makes laws, the executive implements laws, and the judiciary interprets laws in cases.
lessons.example: Shortcut: associate each branch with one primary function, then check the wording of the question.

lessons.title: RA 6713 ethical decision-making
lessons.body: Public officials should prioritize public interest, professionalism and accountability.
lessons.example: Shortcut: eliminate choices involving personal gain, preferential treatment or misuse of resources.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “concise”?
questions.explanation: Concise means expressing information clearly in few words.

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: Each of the students have a notebook.
Each of the students has a notebook.
Each of students have a notebook.
questions.explanation: The singular subject each takes the singular verb has.

questions.prompt: Choose the antonym of “abundant.”
questions.explanation: Scarce means insufficient or in short supply.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses “their” correctly?
questions.explanation: Their is a possessive determiner modifying project.

questions.prompt: What is 15% of 240?
A shirt costs ₱800 and is discounted by 25%. What is the sale price?
questions.explanation: Discount = ₱200; sale price = ₱800 − ₱200 = ₱600.

questions.prompt: Find the next number: 3, 6, 12, 24, __.
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 2.

questions.prompt: The ratio of boys to girls is 2:3. If there are 30 students, how many are girls?
questions.explanation: Girls make up 3 of 5 equal parts: 30 × 3/5 = 18.

questions.prompt: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are yellow. Which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: The first premise directly establishes that every rose is a flower.

questions.prompt: If A is taller than B, and B is taller than C, which is true?
questions.explanation: Height comparison is transitive: A > B > C.

questions.prompt: Complete the pattern: A, C, F, J, O, __.
questions.explanation: Alphabet positions increase by 2, 3, 4, 5, then 6: O (15) + 6 = U (21).

questions.prompt: Which name comes first in alphabetical filing order?
questions.explanation: Ramos comes before Reyes, Rivera, and Rodriguez alphabetically.

questions.prompt: Which pair of reference numbers matches exactly?
questions.explanation: Both entries are exactly XZ-9901.

questions.prompt: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: Accommodation is spelled with double c and double m.

questions.prompt: Which document is the supreme law of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Constitution is the supreme law of the land.

questions.prompt: Republic Act No. 6713 is also known as the ____.
options: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees
questions.explanation: RA 6713 sets ethical standards for public officials and employees.

questions.prompt: Which branch of government interprets laws?
questions.explanation: The judiciary interprets and applies the law in cases before courts.

questions.prompt: Which action best demonstrates environmental responsibility?
options: Segregating and properly disposing of waste
questions.explanation: Waste segregation and proper disposal reduce environmental harm.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to 'meticulous'?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.
questions.hint: Compare the precise meaning of each option.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Neither of the answers are correct.
Neither of the answers is correct.
questions.explanation: Neither is singular here and takes 'is'.
questions.hint: Identify the grammatical subject, not the nearest noun.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the clearest parallel structure?
options: She likes reading, swimming, and to hike.
She likes to read, swimming, and hikes.
She likes reading, swimming, and hiking.
She likes read, swim, and hiking.
questions.explanation: All three activities use the -ing form.
questions.hint: Compare the grammatical forms in the list.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that best completes: 'The committee reached a ____ decision after reviewing all evidence.'
questions.explanation: Deliberate means carefully considered.
questions.hint: Use the context of reviewing evidence.

questions.prompt: What is 12.5% of 320?
questions.explanation: 12.5% is one eighth; 320 ÷ 8 = 40.
questions.hint: Express the percentage as a simple fraction.

questions.prompt: A vehicle travels 150 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed is distance divided by time: 150 ÷ 3 = 50 km/h.

questions.prompt: Solve for x: 3x + 7 = 28.
questions.explanation: Subtract 7 then divide by 3: x = 7.

questions.prompt: What is the mean of 8, 10, 12, and 14?
questions.explanation: The sum is 44; 44 ÷ 4 = 11.
questions.hint: Add the values and account for the number of entries.

questions.prompt: A price increases from ₱200 to ₱250. What is the percentage increase?
questions.explanation: Increase is ₱50 relative to original ₱200: 50 ÷ 200 = 25%.
questions.hint: Use the original price as the base.

questions.prompt: All clerks are employees. All employees have ID cards. Which must be true?
options: Some clerks have no ID cards.
questions.explanation: The two universal statements imply all clerks have ID cards.
questions.hint: Follow the direction of the category relationships.

questions.prompt: What comes next: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, __?
questions.explanation: Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9; the next is 11, giving 37.

questions.prompt: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be 10 days later?
questions.explanation: Ten days is one week plus three days: Friday.
questions.hint: Reduce the day count by full weeks.

questions.prompt: Ana is ahead of Ben. Ben is ahead of Carlo. Who is last among the three?
questions.explanation: The order is Ana, Ben, Carlo.
questions.hint: Translate each relation into an ordered list.

questions.prompt: Which number does not belong: 4, 9, 16, 25, 30?
questions.explanation: 4, 9, 16, and 25 are perfect squares; 30 is not.
questions.hint: Look for a common mathematical property.

questions.prompt: If P implies Q and P is true, what must follow?
questions.explanation: Modus ponens: P and P→Q entail Q.

questions.prompt: A box contains only red and blue pens. There are 12 pens and 5 are red. How many are blue?
questions.explanation: 12 − 5 = 7 blue pens.
questions.hint: Use the fact that only two colors are present.

questions.prompt: A is to the left of B, and B is to the left of C. Which order is possible from left to right?
questions.explanation: Both given relations require A, B, C.

questions.prompt: Which constitutional branch primarily enacts national laws in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Congress, the legislative branch, enacts national laws.
questions.hint: Recall the distinct functions of the three branches.
